Ingenuity Pathway Analysis (IPA) revealed that the dysregulated genes were associated with HIF-1A signaling and lung lipid metabolism, as well as with IL-15 and B cell receptor signaling in ENDS-exposed male and female mice, respectively

A & B) The molecular signatures associated with the toxicological effects evaluated immediately after the 6-month exposure were associated with hypoxia signaling (HIF-1α), whereas the molecular changes following the 2-month recovery period were associated with lung lipid metabolism in ENDS-exposed male mice. C & D) In ENDS-exposed female mice, the dysregulated signaling pathways associated with IL-15 and B cell receptor signaling were conserved following the 2-month recovery period

Publication

Altered lung function in mice is a sensitive indicator of lung damage following 6 months of electronic nicotine delivery system (ENDS) aerosol exposure (2026) Alexandra Noël, et al. Am J Physiol Lung Cell Mol Physiol. 2026 May 01;330(5). Figure: F7.
